brands.evidence: Yes — Monzo is a real, licensed UK bank.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a real, licensed UK bank.
client_claims.note: Matches authorisation by the PRA and regulation by the FCA and PRA.

client_claims.text: If you open a Monzo current account, your account is with Monzo Bank Limited itself.
client_claims.note: Facts do not cover the legal entity name.

client_claims.text: The Bank of England lists Monzo as a regulated bank.
client_claims.note: Facts mention PRA authorisation but not the Bank of England listing.

client_claims.text: FSCS would protect eligible deposits up to £120,000 per person across your accounts with Monzo Bank Limited.
client_claims.note: Matches the £120,000 per person FSCS protection.
